name: The Hull Turns Over
prompt: Set a ribbed wooden hull in a rotating cradle. Shipwrights brace the frame as one side lifts clear, exposing the copper plates awaiting the lower seams.

name: The Lofting Floor
prompt: Unroll full-sized hull curves across a pale lofting floor. Carpenters bend battens to the marks and pass new ribs through a wide doorway to a ship skeleton.

name: The Figurehead Yard
prompt: Arrange giant carved figureheads at successive stages beside a dry slip. A carver paints a final eyelid while a crane lifts a finished bird to a waiting bow.

name: The Propeller Court
prompt: Build a sheltered shipyard foundry around a large screw propeller. Workers polish one blade while a wheeled cradle brings a finished shaft up beside a vessel in dry dock.

name: The Sailmakers' Roof
prompt: Cover a broad loft with translucent roofing and hang a half-stitched sail through its central well. Below, riggers feed bundled canvas onto a mast waiting on trestles.
